description: This file contains shell functions related to manipulating boot configuration, including finding entries in the Qualcomm bootconfig partition, reading and updating boot configuration indices, and managing active partition status for device firmware upgrades.

methods.name: bootconfig_find_entry
methods.description: Finds the offset of a partition entry within a bootconfig binary file.

methods.name: bootconfig_rw_index
methods.description: Reads or updates the index value associated with a boot partition in the Qualcomm bootconfig.

methods.name: smempart_next_root
methods.description: Determines the next active root filesystem partition based on current offsets.

methods.name: elecom_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares device for upgrade by reading current bootconfig and setting next root partition.
